clips.title: The story
paras: Tranquil Gardens Cemetery sits just southeast of Darkshire in Duskwood. Despite its peaceful name, the grounds have become overrun with shambling skeletons and ghouls, turning the former burial site into an immediate hazard for the nearby town.

Once a quiet resting place for the departed of Grand Hamlet, Tranquil Gardens Cemetery is now anything but serene. As dark curses settled over Duskwood, the dead buried here began clawing their way out of their plots. While the skeletal warriors, skeletal mages, and wandering undead haunting these gravestones are relatively weak compared to the horrors lurking deeper in the woods, their close proximity to Darkshire poses a relentless threat to the townsfolk.
